process_steps.input_state: high-purity Ni, Co, and V metals (≥99.9%)

evidence.quote: The Ni10Co56.5V33.5 alloy was synthesized by arc melting high-purity Ni, Co, and V metals (≥99.9%) in an atmosphere of high-purity argon.
The cast rods were vacuum-sealed in a quartz tube and homogenized at 1473 K for 24 h, followed by water quenching to preserve the high-temperature state.
The homogenized rods were then cold-rolled longitudinally from a thickness of 8.0 to 1.5 mm, achieving a thickness reduction of 80%.
Recrystallization heat treatment was then conducted on three tensile specimens at 1473 K for 10 min, 1373 K for 3 min and 1473 K for 1 min, respectively, to obtain different grain sizes.
